portInfo.description: This SeaDays entry is the Santiago-market cruise gateway at San Antonio on Chile’s central Pacific coast. DP World holds the multipurpose terminal concession (from 2011) and publishes a 700 m berthing facility with cruise among quayside services. A November 2025 DP World news release marks the 2025–26 cruise season (15 ships, Oct 2025–Apr 2026) and states more than 450,000 visitors since cruise operations began in 2017. Valparaíso is a separate SeaDays port — do not conflate the two.

thingsToDo.intro: Pick one neighbourhood or excursion scale and keep time for the gangway queue on the way back.
topThings: San Antonio coastal walk / market — short call.
Cajón del Maipo / Santiago city — long road day; only with confirmed timing.
Valparaíso/Viña day — separate port city; do not assume same pier.
Wine valleys — Casablanca corridor common on excursions; operator-specific.
thingsToDo.shortCall: Stay near the port area and keep a generous buffer before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.standardCall: Combine a central walk, one attraction, and lunch if times allow—start back well before all-aboard.
thingsToDo.longerCall: A second stop or coach outing is realistic only with confirmed transport and an eight-hour or longer window.
thingsToDo.practicalTip: Your luggage tag may say Santiago, but you are in San Antonio — plan the road time explicitly.
